vo: Why does selling twenty or thirty websites matter? Because the website is not the product. It is the door.

Once a client has their site, you can offer to look after it. I update the pages, I keep it online, I make sure it never expires. A small monthly fee, say ninety nine dollars. And a Bot does the actual work.
Pricing is yours to choose. A one-off fee for the build, then a small monthly fee for care. Keep the plans simple, so the owner can decide in one minute, without a meeting.
Then you mention search. I can also work on your SEO, for a monthly fee. A different plan, a different number.
Then reviews. I can reply to your Google reviews for you. Then, by the way, I am building something that sorts out your accounts.
You keep selling, and Grok Bot keeps doing the work. Every new agent is another small monthly line, built on top of a client who already trusts you.
Think of a restaurant owner you already work with. You build a review agent and give it to them free, because they already pay you every month. It earns trust and it costs you almost nothing.

In the background you build the next ones. A stock agent that watches what is running low. A bookings agent that compares the last thirty days with the next thirty. A finance agent that lines up takings against meat, wages, rent and electricity.

Always test before you sell. Run each agent on your own sample data first, check the answers with your own eyes, and let the client review the first results. A small, correct agent beats a big, clever one.
This is the foot in the door. Once they know you deliver AI agents that work, it is easy to say yes to the next one that fixes a problem they feel every week.
So the whole path is short. Pick a niche you know. Find the pain. Offer one small thing. Land the first sale. Then stack more agents on top, month after month.
If you are not feeling lazy, you can go further. Build a full agency that offers many different agents to businesses anywhere in the world. That is a bigger project, and a different video.
But if you want the quickest start, you now have it. One niche, one page, one offer. Let the Bots work, and keep selling.
